_note: Pre-registered before any LLM answer exists. frozen.json stores this file's hash and score refuses to run if it changed.

conditions.C0: no persona, generic Korean adult, repeated. Not linked to respondents, AUC is n/a.

panel.draw: weighted without replacement on psfwt, test split only, seed 42
panel.analysis_weight: psfwt divided by the Monte Carlo inclusion probability of the draw (5000 draws), because the draw already used psfwt

truth: psfwt weighted cell means over the whole test split, age band by sex, 12 cells
primary_metrics: weighted cell MAE in percentage points
floor_for_switch_rule: logistic on age band and sex dummies, LogisticRegression(C=0.05, max_iter=400), fitted on the train split with psfwt, evaluated on the same 300 gate respondents with the same analysis weights
secondary_floor: same model on all C1 demographics. Reported, not used by the rule.
switch_rule: SWITCH if and only if C1 and C2 AUC are at or below the floor on all 3 items AND no reproducing pattern exists in C1 or C2 on any item. Otherwise NO SWITCH.

reproducing_pattern.definition: A condition and item shows a reproducing pattern when all three checks pass against the test-split truth.

real_sample_baseline.source: rows drawn from the train split
estimators: shrunk toward the sample national mean
real_sample_baseline.empty_cell: falls back to the sample national mean

worth_n: Use the better of raw and shrinkage at each n. A panel that cannot beat the constant baseline prints no value.
no_tuning: Prompts, allowlist, thresholds and code paths in this file are not to be changed after answers are seen.
